title: Narrative essay (reader version)
description: The captivating reader-first output of /api/read. Held as a thin metadata envelope around a markdown body — narrative is a bad fit for JSON-native field-shredding, but the envelope still gives us guarantees about hook, turn, end, and length.

title.description: Names what the lens has just shown.

hook.description: The opening 1–2 sentences, repeated here so the UI can preview without parsing markdown. Must also appear at the top of body_md.

body_md.description: The full essay as markdown. Lowercase exploratory voice; flowing prose, not lists; 600–1200 words; must contain at least one verbatim Bataille quote.

turn_signal.description: One sentence: the moment in the essay where it turns — from describing what the lens reveals to pointing past Bataille at us. The model identifies its own turn so we can audit that the essay actually has one.

ends_on.description: How the essay ends. Tidy resolution is forbidden.
